description: How long a metro journey takes between two stations, with the line changes: each leg with its line, direction (toward) and stops, the walking time at each change, how often trains run now and the expected wait. TRTC covers Taipei and New Taipei (including the Circular line); also Kaohsiung, Taichung and the Taoyuan airport line (express and local). Example: system "TRTC", from "台北車站", to "台北101/世貿".

date.description: Day of travel in Taiwan, YYYY-MM-DD, for how often trains run (default: today).

from.description: Starting station: name (台北車站, 台北101/世貿, Ximen, 美麗島) or station ID (BL12).

system.description: TRTC (臺北捷運 with 新北捷運: 環狀線, 三鶯線), KRTC (高雄捷運), TMRT (臺中捷運) or TYMC (桃園機場捷運).

to.description: Destination station: name (台北車站, 台北101/世貿, Ximen, 美麗島) or station ID (BL12).

name: metro_travel_time
title: Metro journey time
